First, note: 10-01-1370 likely means DD-MM-YYYY, so 10 January 1370.  

6 weeks = 42 days.  
Plus 5 days = 47 days total to subtract.  

January 10 minus 47 days:  
Go back 10 days → 31 December 1369.  
Remaining 37 days:  
December has 31 days, so 31 December minus 37 days:  
Back 31 days → 30 November 1369.  
Remaining 6 days: back 6 more days → 24 November 1369.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1369-11-24
